success.description: Whether the operation succeeded (for `send`, iMessage/WhatsApp legs are fire-and-forget and do not affect this)

errorMessage.description: Error message if the operation failed

proposed.description: True if the notification was proposed for user approval (interactive chat) rather than sent immediately

userMessage.description: UI/agent guidance, e.g. when a notification was proposed rather than sent

muted.description: True if the user has muted every notification channel — nothing was sent
